corrections.text: Option orders are a functional Fisher–Yates over :rand.uniform_s/2, state from :rand.seed_s(:exsss, {seed, item_index * 64 + question_index, order_index}) threaded through; no Enum.shuffle, no process spawn; a golden literal of six orders is pinned in the tests so algorithm drift fails loudly. (S-22)

Kerf.Eval.Manifest.sha256/1 :: {:ok, hex} | {:error, reason}; the run header's manifest_sha256 comes from {:ok, hex} and an error aborts the run before any request. Every public Manifest function returns violation lists; nothing raises, including validate/1 on a malformed question_set (manifest-level :question_def_invalid, emitted once, heads the list). (S-23b, S-26)
A frozen manifest refuses every mutation (:frozen) and a second freeze; ready_for_run?/1 rejects labelled_at or tiered_at after frozen_at. (owner amendments to D1)

Item.seed_category holds the golden-overrides category; labels stay nil until the owner labels. label_sources["category"] is derived: "adjudicated" iff seed_category is set and equals the label, else "new". An overruled override is no longer an adjudication. (S-29)
F09.1 = fail when category easy-tier accuracy < 0.90 regardless of baseline; pending only when easy passes and --baseline-accuracy is nil; pass when both clauses hold. (S-25b)

On the H-9 default synthetic run (244 items, 50 calibration, 194 eval) random failed scaled F09.2 on needs_reply only (0.109, T = 4.15). The log T ∈ [−4, 4] bound was not the cause (the two questions at the bound passed) and the Noul base-rate floor (|0.459 − 0.5| ≈ 0.04) was not the main cause. Cause: NLL temperature fitting on 50 calibration samples of an uninformative model overfits chance correlation to a finite T. A3.2's "reported, not asserted" stands for the correct reason. The bound is not widened. (S-2b)

ece[question] additionally carries fitted_t, calibration_n, calibration_nll, lr_statistic = 2·(baseline_nll_sum − fitted_nll_sum) against Σ ln K, and fit_better = lr_statistic > 3.841 (χ²₁ 95 %, conservative at the T→∞ boundary). report.md shows T, n and the flag beside every scaled ECE. Top-level report keys, temperatures.json and the gate itself are unchanged. (H4c)

F10 and DECISION_FAMILY.md report raw ECE, fitted T and scaled ECE per question. A scaled pass with a raw fail is "calibratable, not calibrated": the model may ship only with its T in config (A3.4's temperatures.json) and F07 drift monitoring is what shows whether T holds. A profile-likelihood band on log T (H4d) is built only if F10's numbers are ambiguous. (S-37)
